articles.title: Aave rolls out vaults for yield-hungry fintech investors
articles.snippet: Aave's new Stable Vaults product lets wallets, exchanges and payment apps offer yields on stablecoin deposits

articles.title: Latin America’s biggest stock exchange now offers options on bitcoin, ether and solana futures
articles.snippet: These options settle into underlying futures contracts rather than spot cryptoassets, involving no custody, transfer, or administration of tokens.

articles.title: Singapore's Temasek investment fund says crypto is off the table, will focus on AI
articles.snippet: The $400 billion wealth fund plans to expand AI holdings to 15% of its portfolio by 2031 from the current 6%.

articles.title: Bank of Japan may speed up rate hikes, pushing borrowing costs above 2%, ex-BOJ official warns
articles.snippet: Former BOJ official issues interest-rate warning as yen continues to slide against the dollar.

articles.title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins
articles.snippet: Sony Bank received preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a US stablecoin issuance business, with $40 million in starting capital.
